data.body: OPEN THREADS AT PAUSE. Wave 1 is CLOSED at 20 artifacts, RESULTS.md regenerated, working tree committed. NOT YET DONE: Wave 2 Q1 (replicability - a second blank-slate round per plan including a second rebar review, to measure how much each source varies against itself; partial data already exists as accidental replicates in artifacts/judge-replicates/INTER_JUDGE.md and ARM_REPLICATES.md, plus 3 CE replicates on bda8-370d-BLOCK) and Wave 2 Q3 (iterations-to-pass: how many remediate/re-review cycles to pass each non-rebar reviewer, cycle cap 6, grounded in rebar's own history across 747 tickets - mean 2.29, median 2, p75 3, p90 4, p95 6, max 16, 45.6% pass first review). Wave 3 sourcing is in flight across 3 disjoint slices and no Wave 3 reviews have been dispatched. Q2 is complete and corrected. The floor-mechanism read is complete. Design docs: WAVES.md, METHODOLOGY.md, harness/PHASE2_DESIGN.md, harness/JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS.md, harness/FIDELITY_LOG.md (every deviation, standing ones included: CE cross-model pass skipped on all runs because the codebase is proprietary, nothing applied, mini and superpowers severity vocabularies are harness-imposed, no spec file exists).
